thread:
Maria: FYI after merging TP+INT8 change Im seeing a p99 tail latency regression on 16-GPU runs, up ~1.6x. Happens on long seqs.
Kevin: I saw those graphs. p50 steady but p99 spikes. Looks like all-reduce time is dominating some steps.
Sasha: Can you grab an nvprof/NCCL timeline? I want to see comm/compute overlap and if NCCL progress is happening.
Maria: Pasted a short trace from one problematic step:
```
Step 1289:
rank0 compute: 12.4ms
rank0 nccl_allreduce: 46.8ms
rank0 idle_wait: 16.2ms
KV remote fetch (tp-shard miss): 8.7ms
kernel fused_qkv_fp16_int8: 5.9ms
```
Kevin: Allreduce >> compute. With TP the per-rank compute window is tiny so comm can't hide. The fused kernel reduces compute which unintentionally increases comm pressure.
Henry: Also INT8 path added dequant/req scaling ops that might be serializing. Check if we do extra host<->device sync during quant steps.
Sasha: Quick checklist: 1) Is `NCCL_ASYNC_PROGRESS` enabled? 2) Any explicit barriers around KV refresh? 3) Kernel scheduling stream affinities?
Maria: We were running with `NCCL_ASYNC_PROGRESS=0` and a couple of debug barriers. Flipping async on improved p99 by ~18% in quick runs.
Kevin: Good. Longer term I think kernel selection heuristic should be quant-aware: prefer slightly heavier kernels that enlarge compute windows when tp_size>1 and seq_len large. Right now we auto-select the most ops-fused kernel which minimizes compute but hurts overlap.
Sasha: I'll draft a small heuristic patch: if (tp>1 && seq>=768 && int8_enabled) pick kernel group "B_unfused_v2". Make it opt-in via `--perf-flag kernel_tp_int8_tuner`.
Henry: On KV: shard KV tables by TP rank so lookups are local for hot prefixes. Cold misses still need cross-rank fetch but those are rarer. Should cut the ~8-9ms cross-device fetchs we see.
Maria: CI created perf/regression RG-4720 with traces attached.
CI-bot: perf/regression created RG-4720 (Maria)  traces: /artifacts/RG-4720/
Kevin: Microbench plan: run 50-step runs with `--trace-nccl --nvtx-sample --no-debug-barriers` and compare (a) baseline fused kernels, (b) kernel_group_B_unfused_v2, (c) same with KV-shard-locality.
Sasha: Also test `NCCL_ASYNC_PROGRESS=1` and try lowering NCCL_BUFFSIZE/chunk size to see if chunked allreduce helps overlapping.
Henry: Note on quant: we currently use global scale per-layer. With TP splits that can force extra all-reduce for scale alignment when merging, so try per-shard scaling where each TP rank keeps its own scale factor until serialize point.
Maria: Quick repro after enabling async progress + removing a debug barrier: p99 improved but not fully fixed. Next try kernel heuristic + KV sharding.
Kevin: I'll run microbench and post summaries. If kernel group B reduces the stalls we can ship the heuristic behind opt-in flag for Dedicated customers first.
Sasha: Follow-up: add a perf test in nightly that exercises TP+INT8 with seq=2048 to catch regressions.
Maria: TL;DR: immediate wins = enable NCCL async progress + remove unnecessary barriers; medium = kernel selection heuristic for TP+INT8; longer = KV-shard locality + quant per-shard scaling. Filing follow-ups and will coordinate patches.
Kevin: ack. Posting results in ~45m.
Sasha: Thanks, team. :rocket:
